name: 1Password Individual for GitHub Students
benefit: One free year of 1Password Individual password manager with included developer tools such as SSH Agent, Shell Plugins and 1Password CLI.
eligibility: Verified post-secondary students eligible for GitHub Student Developer Pack; redemption requires a linked GitHub student account.
duration: One 12-month promotional Individual subscription, redeemable once, even if education continues.
restrictions: Worldwide redemption with US, Canada or EU data-storage region selected once; not valid for Family accounts. After the free year a paid subscription is optional and verified students may qualify for 50% discount.
